capabilities: Plan a backlog of issues into sprints with drag-to-rank
Track work on a sprint board with one column per custom status
Create and edit issue notes with properties and bidirectional links (blocks, parent, relates to)
Pull issues from a linked GitHub or GitLab repository
Run several projects, each with its own folder, key prefix, sprint length and workflow
extras: Repository pulls are one-way (nothing is pushed back); access tokens are stored in Obsidian's secret storage; the plugin has only been tried on desktop; deletion, burndown charts and epic filtering are listed as not yet built.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in issue tracking, so planning sprints and boards usually happens in external tools and the data leaves the vault as searchable, linkable notes.

relations.evidence: Pull from GitHub or GitLab. Link a project to a repository and pull its issues
Link a project to a repository and pull its issues into the project's issues folder

summary: Jira-style project tracker that manages a backlog, sprints and a kanban board where every issue and sprint is a plain Markdown note.
